coordinator.title: Bootstrap the new run safely
coordinator.acceptance: Verify the prepared v 4 build authorization and its 66-test receipt; install matching assignments and exclusive leases; activate control last.

coordinator.title: Reconcile preserved work once
coordinator.acceptance: Import the stopped mapping ledger and exact drafts; distinguish mapped source 51 from proved source 40; do not replay old prerequisite commits.

coordinator.title: Publish a common development baseline
coordinator.acceptance: Combine the two reviewed dependency slices, fix actual shared dispatch failures, run affected tests and publish exact source/tree proof scope.

coordinator.title: Finish isolated original execution transport
coordinator.acceptance: Demonstrate actual process capture with separate user-data roots and unchanged installation/settings/saves; profile-only receipts cannot pass.

coordinator.title: Repair source-store joins on the chosen route
coordinator.consumer: Existing content store and identity APIs
coordinator.acceptance: Reproduce a concrete source mismatch, repair only the shared cause, reject stale or foreign identity without widening parser admission.

coordinator.title: Complete dependency and platform wiring
coordinator.consumer: Real controller, audio and module consumers
coordinator.acceptance: Audit only needed pinned additions, register owned modules, compile consumers and preserve unsupported capabilities explicitly. Existing bevy_gilrs is already enabled on pinned Bevy 0.19.1; do not redo that feature toggle or upgrade Bevy merely to add audio. Publish needed application, engine_bridge and audio module exports early as one additive wiring change so workers can compile consumers without repeated root grants.

coordinator.title: Promote the first connected route
coordinator.consumer: Main and a reproducible user launch
coordinator.acceptance: Accept fresh route and cold-save evidence from frozen source; publish runnable command and remaining scope; inspection is not gameplay parity.

coordinator.title: Prepare later-game boundaries without a second engine
coordinator.acceptance: After the NV route is stable, isolate profile-specific formats and semantic capabilities; identify lawful installed inputs and external-service limits before promising equivalent behavior.

behavior-lead.title: Adopt stopped gameplay packages
behavior-lead.consumer: Compiled execution, save and actor consumers
behavior-lead.acceptance: Map reviewed VM/STATE/ACT commits once; preserve unfinished drafts and exact refusal corrections; report missing validation instead of replaying completed work.

behavior-lead.title: Connect activation to canonical inventory
behavior-lead.consumer: application host consumed by scene input
behavior-lead.acceptance: Use existing source-qualified selection and inventory transaction APIs; one accepted action changes state once; failed admission changes nothing.

behavior-lead.title: Connect supported script events to host tick
behavior-lead.consumer: application host and observable world commands
behavior-lead.acceptance: Admit compiled events in declared order, dispatch bounded supported effects, acknowledge commits and expose unsupported opcodes before effects.

behavior-lead.title: Connect Save and fresh Continue to gameplay
behavior-lead.acceptance: First reproduce the late scene-membership rejection after native host replacement; prepare restore and acknowledge complete host/scene admission before publishing either authority. Reuse existing SaveWorker; a fresh process restores the same inventory, quest state and pending events.

behavior-lead.title: Connect dialogue to durable consequences
behavior-lead.consumer: original menu actions and canonical quest state
behavior-lead.acceptance: Source-selected response commits supported begin/end effects exactly once; cancel/re-enter and unsupported response paths cannot invent rewards.

behavior-lead.title: Connect actor intent to world commands
behavior-lead.consumer: AI packages, movement and animation consumers
behavior-lead.acceptance: Consume actor intent without making presentation authoritative; maintain generation and acknowledgement ordering across unloaded cells.

behavior-lead.title: Make destination activation atomic
behavior-lead.acceptance: Failed destination preparation leaves source state intact; accepted transition commits location and events once and survives cold restore.

behavior-lead.title: Extend one authored playable sequence
behavior-lead.acceptance: Connect consecutive supported actions through visible consequences and cold restore; list exact missing semantics rather than substituting canned stage progression.

engine-lead.title: Adopt stopped engine packages
engine-lead.consumer: Scene host using existing source producers
engine-lead.acceptance: Integrate reviewed physics, asset, world and presentation slices with preserved maps; prioritize missing validation and avoid replaying entire legacy branches.

engine-lead.title: Connect canonical scene boot
engine-lead.acceptance: Compose existing startup/residency/model APIs into a visible source-backed interior; carry leases until unload and distinguish prepared, uploaded and simulation-ready. Coordinate prepared Continue admission with gameplay lead so a late scene-membership refusal preserves both host and visible revision.

engine-lead.title: Connect body motion and camera
engine-lead.acceptance: Input requests move the canonical body through admitted queries; camera follows its own presentation state; refused movement cannot mutate position.

engine-lead.title: Connect player activation to gameplay host
engine-lead.consumer: input selection and application command boundary
engine-lead.acceptance: Stable source identity reaches gameplay once per admitted action; cancelled/stale selections do not fire events.

engine-lead.title: Connect actor pose and equipment to rendering
engine-lead.acceptance: Consume prepared skin/pose/attachment results with source hashes and real frame upload; no invented root transforms or silent missing-bone success.

engine-lead.title: Connect doors and region lifetimes
engine-lead.consumer: world transition and gameplay destination command
engine-lead.acceptance: Prepare destination, verify actual render/collision readiness, commit once, then drain old leases; failed load retains the old scene.

engine-lead.title: Connect original menu and audio actions
engine-lead.acceptance: Menu focus owns input while active; confirmed gameplay receipts drive HUD/voice; cancelled dialogue stops only its own audio stream.

engine-lead.title: Remove measured route stalls
engine-lead.consumer: real host timing and resource telemetry
engine-lead.acceptance: Fix largest reproduced CPU/upload/IO stall with bounded queues and before/after replay data; maintain source and save results.

scripts.title: Finish preserved VM37/38 consumer validation
scripts.acceptance: Retain committed VM37 and four-file VM38 draft; run missing real command cases and refusal paths without recreating completed operand work.

scripts.title: Execute an ordered activation event batch
scripts.acceptance: Use existing execution admission and source-qualified owners; commit supported effects once, retain instruction budget and reject unsupported operands.

scripts.title: Persist suspended supported event state
scripts.acceptance: Define and consume explicit serializable continuation for supported waits; cold restore equals uninterrupted run, stale source plans reject.

scripts.title: Execute quest-stage effects without guesses
scripts.acceptance: Resolve source-authored stage fragments and conditions; stage setter routes through canonical state; unsupported functions never become zero.

scripts.title: Execute conversation begin/end fragments
scripts.acceptance: Bind correct speaker/target, preserve ordering, prevent duplicate response effects on retry and leave no partial mutation on refusal.

scripts.title: Implement next measured high-frequency opcode family
scripts.acceptance: Use route census only to select a needed missing family; add measured semantics, actual host consumer and boundary/negative examples.

scripts.title: Harden compiled control flow under malformed inputs
scripts.acceptance: Bound stack, jumps, recursion and decode lengths; reject malformed source before effects; differential fixtures must include failing mutations.

scripts.title: Close event lifecycle and unload cancellation
scripts.acceptance: Pending owned events retain valid context or cancel explicitly across unload/reload; cold restore has no duplicate or lost admitted events.

runtime.title: Finish preserved save 39/40 fork work
runtime.acceptance: Preserve six modified files and fork.rs; supply missing tests, compile the actual draft, verify fork ancestry and failed-write isolation.

runtime.title: Complete lifecycle 36-38 host admission
runtime.acceptance: Reuse finished producer commits; reproduce source identity, stale-generation and transaction refusal at actual consumer boundaries.

runtime.title: Support gameplay save and fresh Continue
runtime.acceptance: One durable snapshot captures accepted inventory/reference/event state; restart separately, reject wrong profile and recover interrupted publication.

runtime.title: Commit inventory actions atomically
runtime.acceptance: Apply existing transfers and equipment state in one canonical transaction; invalid count/context/capacity leaves both sides unchanged.

runtime.title: Persist dialogue and quest outcomes
runtime.acceptance: Durable accepted outcome and event acknowledgements survive save/retry; no duplicate reward or fabricated stage default.

runtime.title: Persist cell transitions and actor lifetime
runtime.acceptance: Atomic destination/reference revision and event state; stale residency tickets cannot overwrite a newer save.

runtime.title: Bound save memory and cancellation
runtime.consumer: save worker used during actual scene play
runtime.acceptance: Measure queue bytes, cancel superseded owned requests, preserve previous committed file on injected failures and report terminal outcomes.

runtime.title: Validate migration against real current formats
runtime.acceptance: Reject incompatible source/schema atomically, migrate only supported versions and independently compare canonical relationships after restore.

actors.title: Finish preserved ACT33/34 milestone
actors.consumer: existing actor inspector and runtime rules
actors.acceptance: Keep eleven-path draft; fix known Clippy failure, run missing CLI proof and retain 67-test evidence without declaring unrun proof passed.

actors.title: Publish source-backed actor spawn state
actors.consumer: gameplay host and scene actor consumer
actors.acceptance: Resolve templates/inventory/equipment/stats using existing admitted sources; missing/chance-dependent behavior stays explicit.

actors.title: Drive a supported package lifecycle
actors.acceptance: Ordered start/change/end with source identity, bounded selection and no successful no-op on unsupported package type.

actors.title: Drive equipment changes through actor intent
actors.acceptance: One canonical equip command produces validated slot/weapon response and animation request; refused equipment preserves prior state.

actors.title: Implement measured damage and death response
actors.consumer: supported combat action and animation consumer
actors.acceptance: Connect admitted damage through health/limb/death state and one event response; numeric edge cases measured and saved.

actors.title: Persist actor schedules across cell lifetime
actors.acceptance: Unload/reload retains supported package and references without duplicating actors or resetting admitted state.

actors.title: Connect dialogue eligibility to canonical actor state
actors.acceptance: Template-derived factions/relationships/stats come from the same admitted actor context as gameplay; reject ambiguous speakers.

actors.title: Extend one route-required actor behavior
actors.acceptance: Choose a missing package/combat/interaction behavior from actual route failure, implement producer and observable host result with negative tests.

assets.title: Finish stopped spline and skin package
assets.acceptance: Preserve six held packages and compact-spline draft; settle unsealed verification against immutable inputs and run missing source cases.

assets.title: Deliver sampled animation to visible actor
assets.acceptance: Produce validated time-sampled pose from admitted controllers; source hashes, joint order and bindings match rendered actor.

assets.title: Support equipment and weapon attachment poses
assets.consumer: actor intent and model attachment consumer
assets.acceptance: Compose local hierarchy and attachment transforms from admitted source; reject missing binding instead of substituting identity.

assets.title: Handle animation transition and interruption
assets.acceptance: Support bounded known transitions, cancellation and boundary events; separate clip time from rendering frame count. Test nonzero clip start, final text keys, interrupted clips and loop crossings so sound/action markers fire once at the correct boundary.

assets.title: Preserve actor animation across cold restore
assets.consumer: runtime animation intent and engine host
assets.acceptance: Restore canonical request/time under matching source fingerprint; missing/changed clip cannot silently replace playback.

assets.title: Handle independent rigs and malformed palettes
assets.acceptance: Demonstrate multiple source rig structures and negative bounds/weights cases; no player-only names or truncated strongest-weight assumption without evidence.

assets.title: Reduce measured pose and upload cost
assets.acceptance: Cache immutable bindings and batch changed palettes within memory limits; benchmark same visible output and source rejection behavior.

assets.title: Add next unsupported route asset controller
assets.acceptance: Use actual host failure to choose supported controller family, trace full source rule and prove both decoded result and visible consumer.

world.title: Finish stopped WORLD35/37 native proof
world.acceptance: Retain clean committed work and 133 focused tests; run the missing 15 actual native cases, not a repeat source census.

world.title: Drive adjacent region residency
world.acceptance: Use existing jobs/tickets with priority and hysteresis; reverse crossings do not duplicate roots and late completions cannot publish stale scenes. Test worldspace replacement with a reused cell/block key and a delayed old completion; generation must participate in identity.

world.title: Prepare authored door destinations
world.acceptance: Resolve source destination/context and arrival transform; failure preserves current scene and source leases; readiness remains explicit. Join doors and destinations by qualified identity, never by zipping lists after filtering renderable models.

world.title: Drain source and cache lifetimes on unload
world.consumer: engine residency and retained resource users
world.acceptance: Cancel obsolete work, retain live dependencies, release after final consumer; repeated crossing returns counters within budget.

world.title: Recover cache publication after interruption
world.consumer: existing importer/cache used by host boot
world.acceptance: Inject interruption before/after completion marker; correct source/options digest invalidates only affected entries and installed inputs remain untouched. A header-only output or absent mandatory resource cannot satisfy a complete cache receipt; failure and cancellation join owned workers before publication.

world.title: Connect terrain and lighting sources
world.acceptance: Finish held source producers; correct lease/version/texture role reach renderer; unsupported material cannot masquerade as faithful fallback.

world.title: Resolve dialogue/world membership for a route
world.acceptance: Use existing narrative membership and winning override context; wrong cell/source/speaker produces explicit refusal.

world.title: Bound streaming memory under long traversal
world.acceptance: Measure queued/resident/retained bytes and evict by valid lifetime; looping route stays bounded and restored references retain state.

presentation.title: Finish stopped VIEW packages and corrections
presentation.acceptance: Adopt held 22/23/24/31/32/25 with exact proof scope; finish private 30/33 only after reading their actual state and far-frustum correction.

presentation.title: Render original font glyphs and menu text
presentation.acceptance: Extend existing includes/traits/dependencies/images/rectangles with validated font pages and text layout; render actual menu text with bounded inputs.

presentation.title: Route keyboard and controller actions by focus
presentation.acceptance: Separate gameplay/menu/console focus, release held actions on transitions and test reconnect/rebinding without duplicate activation. Reuse existing held-state quarantine and monotone context intents in input.rs; add the real gameplay action consumer instead of rewriting the input guard.

presentation.title: Display canonical inventory and interaction menus
presentation.acceptance: Menu rows and selection reflect source-backed state; accepted transfer updates visibly once, refusal leaves old UI state and explains cause. Preserve physical button identity when hidden or unaccelerated rows are filtered; reject stale or invalid quantity submissions through the canonical transaction.

presentation.title: Display source-selected dialogue and subtitles
presentation.acceptance: Real selected options/response text, cancellation and focus restoration; voice timing consumes audio receipt rather than arbitrary sleeps. Test source text encoding explicitly and keep shortcut/response indices stable when options are filtered.

presentation.title: Render source animation and attachments
presentation.acceptance: Wire prepared palette updates and equipped models through actual render lifecycle; source/bounds mismatch visible as unsupported, not success.

presentation.title: Complete matched interior/exterior materials
presentation.acceptance: Correct material roles, normal/alpha/UV handling and camera captures; optional enhancements stay separate from original profile.

presentation.title: Remove actual scene frame stalls
presentation.acceptance: Batch measured hot upload/draw path, preserve output within declared tolerances and enforce retained texture/model memory budget.

physics.title: Finish adoption of held finite-query work
physics.acceptance: Preserve 23-27/36 exact commits and 99 Rust/112 native cases; reconcile approved 4-step mapper against actual new parent before further edits.

physics.title: Drive body sweeps from movement requests
physics.acceptance: Consume existing authored query shapes; wall/floor/support/clearance failures refuse motion without moving camera authority into physics.

physics.title: Handle steps, slopes and contact transitions
physics.acceptance: Use measured or explicitly engineering parameters; demonstrate doorway/step/slope fixtures and 30/60/120 render-frame invariance.

physics.title: Validate destination clearance
physics.acceptance: Check arrival against prepared destination collision; invalid placement prevents transition commit and retains source scene.

physics.title: Drive supported actor navigation corridors
physics.acceptance: Resolve source nav/collision bounds, produce bounded path and local motion requests; impossible destinations refuse without endless retries.

physics.title: Update moving collision owners safely
physics.acceptance: Revisioned owner transforms update queries; stale and nonfinite changes refuse, removed objects cannot remain query hits.

physics.title: Keep movement stable across save and rebasing
physics.acceptance: Same source-coordinate result after cold restore and repeated local-origin changes; no accumulated world drift.

physics.title: Optimize measured broad phase and query work
physics.acceptance: Benchmark candidate counts/query time/memory and compare independent exact fixtures; avoid speculative engine replacement.

audio.title: Build bounded source sound preparation
audio.consumer: new audio consumer using existing VFS
audio.acceptance: Resolve source-qualified audio through existing resource leases; validate format lengths/channels/rates and report unsupported codecs without silent success. Include truncated format chunks, zero sample rate/channel counts, oversized declared payload and decoder-cancellation fixtures.

audio.title: Play actual admitted sound requests
audio.consumer: audio event adapter in scene host
audio.acceptance: Finite bounded queue, cancellation and error-bearing completion; generation prevents stale voice/effect completion in a newer scene.

audio.title: Stream music without unbounded decoding
audio.acceptance: Bound decoded samples and worker lifetime; seek/stop cancels own stream; decoder failure is distinct from natural end.

audio.title: Play dialogue voice with an observable clock
audio.acceptance: Selected source cue starts once, clock drives subtitles, cancel/re-enter isolates old playback and missing voice remains explicit. Drive timing from the observable playback clock, not render dt; prepare/decode off the frame thread and distinguish decode failure from natural completion.

audio.title: Apply source-backed spatial sound
audio.acceptance: Document measured attenuation/direction semantics; fixture verifies transforms and channel behavior without invented faithful constants.

audio.title: Persist supported music and radio intent
audio.acceptance: Save canonical source cue and supported position, restore with source check and no duplicate streams; unsupported radio rules declared.

audio.title: Handle device loss, pause and focus changes
audio.acceptance: Recover or visibly refuse device change, no leaked worker/buffer; menu pause follows explicit supported policy.

audio.title: Connect supported original media cues
audio.acceptance: Select route-required media format and present real source content with bounded lifetime and cancellation; no copied retail assets in Git.

behavior-acceptance.title: Build independent route replay assertions
behavior-acceptance.acceptance: Implement input/state/event capture and expectation schema; deliberately wrong inventory, quest or acknowledgement must fail.

behavior-acceptance.title: Prove fresh-process inventory Continue
behavior-acceptance.acceptance: Normal activation/transfer/save/exit/restart restores source-qualified inventory; capture process and input provenance. Inject late scene-membership rejection and prove canonical host and displayed revision both retain the prior state.

behavior-acceptance.title: Prove script ordering and cancellation
behavior-acceptance.acceptance: Independent expected trace catches missing/duplicate/reordered effects, wrong owner and unsupported-opcode success.

behavior-acceptance.title: Prove dialogue consequence persistence
behavior-acceptance.acceptance: Assert actual option/response/effects and cancellation, cold restore and retry; canned quest setter cannot satisfy acceptance.

behavior-acceptance.title: Prove actor lifecycle through unloading
behavior-acceptance.acceptance: Detect duplicate/reset actors, lost intent and wrong template context after leave/return/save/restart.

behavior-acceptance.title: Add interrupted-write and stale-source acceptance
behavior-acceptance.acceptance: Kill only owned harness child at declared boundary; last valid save survives; altered source/profile and damaged receipts reject.

behavior-acceptance.title: Import isolated original behavior traces
behavior-acceptance.acceptance: Verify actual binary/profile/input/process evidence and compare units/order; synthetic fixtures cannot receive retail-pass status.

behavior-acceptance.title: Grow accepted normal-input sequences
behavior-acceptance.acceptance: Each new sequence has prerequisites, actual input, independent state/visible exit and unsupported inventory; never label full campaign from one route.

engine-acceptance.title: Build frozen scene replay harness
engine-acceptance.acceptance: Pin source/binary/input/camera/resource manifest; independent missing-resource and changed-pose mutations fail expected assertions. Reject stale captures and all-skipped runs; validate per-run completion and distinguish absent observations from passing results.

engine-acceptance.title: Prove scene boot and graceful shutdown
engine-acceptance.acceptance: Capture first visible content, frame readiness and complete resource drain; no empty console/window counted as scene success.

engine-acceptance.title: Prove movement and camera separation
engine-acceptance.acceptance: Replay wall/step/doorway and frame-rate variants; compare canonical pose independently from camera transform and cold restore.

engine-acceptance.title: Prove door transitions and failed loads
engine-acceptance.acceptance: Reverse/retry/cancel routes leave one scene authority, no duplicate roots and old state intact on destination failure.

engine-acceptance.title: Prove actor skin and menu glyph rendering
engine-acceptance.acceptance: Use source-derived fixtures and matched camera captures; missing palettes/font pages fail instead of accepting placeholders.

engine-acceptance.title: Prove bounded traversal memory and timing
engine-acceptance.acceptance: Measure IO/queue/upload/resident maxima with fixed workload; capture regression thresholds and error provenance.

engine-acceptance.title: Prove audio lifecycle and subtitle timing
engine-acceptance.acceptance: Independent sample/clock observations detect duplicate voice, silence-as-success, cancelled callbacks and stream leaks.

engine-acceptance.title: Compare matched original scene captures
engine-acceptance.acceptance: Validate capture provenance and exact camera/profile; quantify visual/timing differences, never use engineering demo as 1:1 evidence.

dependency_contract: Production consumers may start on a tested, named consumable dependency slice while its producer feature remains open. The full producer exit still requires the actual consumer. Proof and promotion dependencies require completed acceptance evidence, not merely a published harness or API. Update the same package receipt; do not add per-helper handoffs.
